steps.content: [Blue fragmented dynamic background]

All she sees is darkness. In her ears, a constant buzzing drones on, thin and persistent as a cloud of mosquitoes. She tries to swat it away, but the weight holds her down. Her body is impossibly heavy, her arms leaden and useless.

Her body lies pinned beneath a massive weight, unable to move despite your greatest efforts. As restlessness stirs within her, the buzzing in her ears grows louder, gradually coalescing into sounds that almost resemble comprehensible words.
[Dream, Xiaofeng's Past. Background: Mountain Woods in Eastia]

steps.speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
steps.content: Oh, you're awake. Finally! How's the leg feel?
The disheveled child bolted upright, only to accidentally jostle the wound on her leg and collapse back down.
A pair of hands was reaching out from the side, gently touching her skin. The girl with the herb basket crouched beside the child, her eyes brimming with concern.

steps.speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
steps.content: Does it hurt a lot? That's no good. The wound's gone bad. The herbs need more time to work.

Something cold pressed against the leg. Almost on reflex, the child's jaws snapped shut around the girl's wrist. A pulse throbbed beneath sharp fangs; the wrist was so slender it seemed as though it might shatter under the slightest pressure.

steps.speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
steps.content: Shh... shh... It's okay. I promise it won't hurt much...
The girl did not pull away. Instead, she kept speaking in a soothing voice, using her free hand to show the child the herbs she held.

steps.speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
steps.content: I found you while I was picking herbs. The snow had almost buried you. Lucky thing, it's just scratches and bruises. Nothing's broken. Two weeks, maybe, and you'll be good as new.

steps.speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
steps.content: Nobody comes up here this time of year. Tigers hunt here. Wild things. It's dangerous. You must've had your reasons...

There had been no hostility. This was not an enemy. Catching the scent of common hemostatic herbs, the child determined the stranger posed no threat. Only then did she give the girl's wrist a perfunctory lick before pulling away.
The girl's hands moved swiftly and gently. Within moments, she had dressed the wound properly and secured it with a decorative red cord.

steps.speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
steps.content: There. All done.
The girl patted the child's head and smoothed out the tangled hair. But the moment she turned away, the child shook her head and tested her limbs, preparing to bolt.
Unfortunately, the escape attempt had been cut short before it even began. The girl had caught and pinned the child down once more.

steps.speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
steps.content: Your leg needs rest. You'll have to stay at the temple for now. Don't worry, I'll come up every day. Bring plenty of medicine... Hm?
A faint rustling sound drew her attention. The girl turned to find that fuzzy head had somehow crept close, and was sniffing intently at the cloth pouch hanging from her waist.
The girl slapped her forehead and pulled out two round, flat objects from her waist pouch.

steps.speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
steps.content: Oh! How could I forget—

The disheveled child remained guarded at first, only leaning in to sniff. But the aroma had proved irresistible. She took a tentative bite from the girl's hand and swallowed without tasting. Then another bite. Her eyes lit up.

This time, the taste registered fully. She snatched the rest and devoured it, meat juices smearing across her mouth. After savoring every last morsel and licking her fingers clean, she looked up expectantly, her hand reaching toward the pouch for more.

steps.speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
steps.content: Haha! Drink some water first. Slow down. I'll bring more meat pies tomorrow when I come back—
Before she could finish, the girl noticed the child had grabbed another gourd and was gulping it down.
The child blinked. The girl before her had seemed to multiply into eight identical copies, each face etched with anxiety, all shaking her shoulders and urging her to spit it out.

steps.speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
steps.content: No! That's for cleaning wounds! You can't drink that!
...Burp...
Warmth flooded through her body. The child tried to stand and take a few steps, but the world tilted and spun around her. Once more, she collapsed face-first onto the ground.

steps.speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
steps.content: Yes?
I'm... strong... Not... stupid...
Bad things... killed them. All gone. Here... my place. Safe now...

As she spoke, the child's eyes began to glaze over, her eyelids growing heavy and drooping. Her words slurred into incomprehensible murmurs. The girl didn't know whether to laugh or cry, and could only coax her gently, lifting the water to her lips.

steps.speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
steps.content: Alright, alright. I hear you...

steps.speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
steps.content: Rest now... May the Mountain Lord watch over you. When you wake and your wounds are healed... you can go down the mountain...
[Syndicate Street]

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hahaha, this place is great!
Xiaofeng leaps down from the building, her voice brimming with barely contained excitement.

The wind howls past your ears, tangled with the boom of her laughter. Slung over her shoulder, you are nothing but dead weight as she weaves through the city, the clamor of the chase fading behind you. The relentless jostling churns your insides until your stomach finally reaches its limit.
Okay, okay! Whatever you want, we'll talk! But if you don't want me puking down your back, put me down—!

A soft chuckle drifts down from above. You are lifted once more, then gently lowered until your feet finally meet solid ground. When you look up, the culprit herself is crouched before you, regarding you with undisguised curiosity.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Still scrawny. Don't you ever use those muscles? They starvin' you here or what?

options: I'm in way better shape than last time.

choices.text: I'm in way better shape than last time.

steps.content: Look, business first. You wanted me to play guide, right? Answer a few questions, and I'm yours for the day.
Xiaofeng tilts her head. Apparently, a simple outing isn't supposed to involve this many conditions.
The amusement park. That was you, right? The kids who went missing with you. Where are they?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Barbecue stall over there. Eating skewers. Those cats too.
And the missing jewelry... Wait. Barbecue stall? How'd you pay?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: You humans like shiny rocks. So I gave 'em to the meat guy. Left some on the fake cat suit too, but nobody grabbed 'em. Were they fake?
What about your tiger? It's already been taken back to the MBCC. Aren't you worried?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Meowy? Nah. We play first. When she misses me, she'll find her own way back.

Xiaofeng plops down beside you and cheerfully launches into the tale of her journey to DisCity. She tells you how she and her tiger stow away on a cargo ship bound for the city, one that conveniently delivers them straight into Syndicate. Unable to locate you right away, she simply wanders around, content to wait for you to come find her instead.

She gesticulates wildly as she recounts the adventure, utterly oblivious to the chaos she has left in her wake. You cover your face, struggling to contain your exasperation, and manage to pose another question.

So let me get this straight. The mighty Mountain Lord graces DisCity with her presence because...? Because right now it's feeling less like a friendly visit and more like you're just yanking my chain...

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: To have fun, of course!

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: After you and that plum branch girl left, all the troublemakers back there got themselves killed or busted up. Boring! But this place? So much noise! So much going on! And the people here are real friendly, practically throwing gifts at me!
Xiaofeng licks her lips with satisfaction. You do not dare to dwell on what she truly means when she says people "throw gifts at her."
Still, keeping her under your watch is surely better than letting her roam free and wreak havoc.
...Fine. Just—please—stop wandering off alone. You'll just get grabbed again. Where else do you wanna go? I'll take you myself.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Oh! Yeah, I saw lots of good stuff on the way in—
Xiaofeng's eyes light up. A wave of dread washes over you, but before you can muster a single word of protest, you are hoisted up by your collar once more.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Be a good little guide, yeah? Stick with me. I'll show you how to really have a good time!
[Syndicate Street]
In the end, you severely underestimate what Xiaofeng means by "having a good time."

The list, as it turns out, includes mooching meals, pilfering trinkets, storming gang trafficking deals, and stirring up general chaos. If something piques her interest, moral boundaries simply cease to exist.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Cargo? What cargo?
You try asking Xiaofeng why she attacks the gangs that smuggle goods from Eastia. She tilts her head, her expression one of genuine bafflement at the question.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Ohhh, those metal boxes? Yeah, the stuff inside was boring. But those wooden sticks on top? Those were good. Can't even find sticks that nice back home.

After several chaotic escapades, you have gotten a read on how Xiaofeng operates. She thrives on mischief and excitement, always diving headfirst into danger, her body moving long before her brain even catches up.
As for dealing with the aftermath...

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Ahahahaha!
The philosophy is obvious: fight first, and if that does not work, run!
All you can do is stay behind Xiaofeng and pull your coat over your face, just in case tomorrow's wanted posters happen to feature the Minos Chief before they get around to featuring her.
[Keylan Square]
Evening settles over the plaza, where crowds gather for the festivities below. You and Xiaofeng stand above it all, perched on the edge of a high rooftop.

Several clay jars sit beside Xiaofeng, silent evidence of multiple rounds of drinking. You decline her invitation to join, but she hardly seems to care. She sprawls out completely, as though the rooftop beneath her is nothing more than an oversized cat tower built for her personal comfort.

The festival lights below cast dancing shadows around her, shifting and flickering. She watches the patterns beside her hand for a long, focused moment before finally lunging, only to swipe at empty air. The sight reminds you of those plump cats always lounging outside the Bureau, chasing things only they can see.
Pfft...
Your laughter earns you an eye roll from Xiaofeng.
She lets out a burp, shaking off the last of her drunken haze as she rises to her feet. She dusts herself off with casual indifference and calls down to the children watching from below.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Oi! You kids down there!

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: New to this city. What's worth knowing around here? Someone tell me a good one. Make it interesting. I got candy.

The children below startle at first, flinching back before the candy in Xiaofeng's hand works its magic. After a brief hesitation, hands shoot into the air as they eagerly compete for her attention. Xiaofeng surveys the small crowd for a moment, then casually points at one who has pushed her way to the front.

steps.speaker: Onlooking Child
steps.content: I know all about the Sinners! There's Zoya, a cool lady who runs the Legion! And EMP, the Uncrowned Ruler of Syndicate, who calls down lightning! And... and the little mouse Hella! Nobody beats Hella in WhiteSands!

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Yeah? Not bad. Catch.

Xiaofeng tosses down a handful of candy, and the children watch it rain down upon them. Seeing that she keeps her word, they buzz with fresh anticipation, eager for whatever question she might ask next.

steps.speaker: Onlooking Child
steps.content: Me! Me! Pick me! I got another one!

steps.speaker: Onlooking Child
steps.content: This one's from Eastia! Heard it from a trader at the Drifter Camp...
[See if we can use an Eastian background for this sequence]

steps.speaker: Onlooking Child
steps.content: Long time ago, during a big war in Eastia, a whole village ran away. Settled at the bottom of a huge mountain.

steps.speaker: Onlooking Child
steps.content: But the mountain was dangerous. Hunters had to stick together or the beasts would get 'em.

steps.speaker: Onlooking Child
steps.content: One day, a kid wandered off and got lost on the trail. His mama cried and cried, yelled herself hoarse, searched everywhere... couldn't find him...

steps.speaker: Onlooking Child
steps.content: Then one day, he just walked back down!

steps.speaker: Onlooking Child
steps.content: Yeah! Not a scratch on him either! Said he met a big tiger in the mountains, its fur all silvery-white. The tiger watched over him, gave him a red string bracelet, and showed him the way down!

steps.speaker: Onlooking Child
steps.content: Everyone said the Tiger Deity blessed him. After that, people wore red strings going up the mountain. Left offerings too. With the Tiger Deity watching, they weren't scared of anything!
[Back to AVG]
The first child tells the story with such vivid detail that the others around her gasp in wonder.

steps.speaker: Onlooking Child
steps.content: Wait... Where'd the Tiger Deity come from, though?

steps.speaker: Onlooking Child
steps.content: Dummy! That tiger's a deity! It was always there!
Didn't know your greatest hits made it all the way to DisCity. Right, Mountain Lord?

You mean to tease her, but the words are met with silence. When you glance over, you find Xiaofeng's face bathed in the glow of neon lights. She seems to be smiling yet you cannot quite read what lies beneath it.
...Xiaofeng?
[White flash + flashlight click, screen shake]

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Hey! You two up there, get down! Now!

A sharp command shatters the gathering like a stone through glass. The children scatter in an instant, melting into the shadows. The searchlight sweeps upward, its beam catching the two figures perched above—you and Xiaofeng. Time to make yourselves scarce.
But... knowing Xiaofeng, there is no way she makes a conventional exit.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hah! Good timing. Belly's full, so I could use a stretch. Alright, folks! Got coin? Toss it. No coin? Clap loud. I'll take that too!

Xiaofeng stands atop the Keylan statue, an imposing silhouette against the night sky, looking down at the officers below with their batons and shields raised. Her loose coat snaps and billows in the wind, alive with motion.
But just before she pounces, a glint of light flashes across her vision.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: ?! What's that?!

Instinct takes over. Xiaofeng lunges headfirst toward the glint in the flower bed, and everything she has somehow collected—candy, colorful scraps, trinkets, loose gems and pearls—goes flying in a dazzling cascade around her.

As for you... you quickly switch off the flashlight, tug your collar up to hide your all-too-recognizable face, and slip past the officers. Amid the children's delighted gasps and the officers' confused shouts, you dash to the flower bed to pull her out of the chaos.
[Scene Change: Syndicate Back Alley]
You sprint through the winding back alleys of Syndicate, dragging Xiaofeng along by the hand.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Huh. Look at you. Those legs actually work.
Had to learn. Someone around here's even quicker, and way worse at staying out of trouble.
You gasp for breath, and the words that escape you come out sharper than intended, though Xiaofeng doesn't seem to mind in the slightest. Her voice remains light, still threaded with amusement.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Heh. So you noticed, huh? How'd you figure I'd go chasing after that little flash of light?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Sharp eyes. I like that. You ever think about ditching all this and running with me instead?
And do what, exactly?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Go wherever the road takes us. Eat big, drink deep, pick a fight when the mood strikes. Simple as that.
Gonna have to turn that one down.
Your answer comes swift and resolute, carrying an edge that is almost righteous in its certainty.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Ah, too bad. Real inconvenient timing, too, 'cause those boys ahead look like they've got their sights set on both of us...

Xiaofeng's voice drops. Before you can process what is happening, a sharp tug yanks you backward and straight into an embrace that reeks of alcohol. You open your mouth to protest, but her hand clamps down on your head, pressing your face firmly against her chest.

Shh— Xiaofeng presses a finger to her lips, then gestures ahead. Through the dim glow cast by a nearby bar's garish neon signs, you make out shapes shifting in the darkness. An unmarked truck idles at the mouth of the alley. Two groups of figures dressed in black scan the area, their gazes wary and searching.
The man leading them slowly turns his head, revealing a face marred by scars. His eyes settle on you and Xiaofeng, frozen there in your awkward embrace.

steps.speaker: Figure in Black 1
steps.content: ...Who's that? One of yours?

steps.speaker: Figure in Black 2
steps.content: Nope. Thought you called for extra hands.

Good news: they haven't recognized you. Bad news: they clearly have no intention of letting you go. The men in black shift to block the alley entrance, their hands sliding into their jackets, ready to draw a gun at a moment's notice.

You are still weighing your options when Xiaofeng suddenly flashes her fangs in a grin and pulls you forward two steps. Her gait wavers, every movement dripping with drunken haze. She is the picture of a tipsy fool who has stumbled into the wrong alley.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hey now. My friend here might've had a few, but the name still carries weight. Take a good look. This is the one and only Noms Chief.

steps.speaker: Figure in Black 2
steps.content: Noms Chief? You mean this sorry sack with the collar up trying to look mysterious? And you, an idiot gnawing on a stick?
The men's eyes dart between you and Xiaofeng, uncertain and searching. Then they lock onto her face, and something clicks.

steps.speaker: Figure in Black 1
steps.content: Wait... tall. White hair. Ears on her head...

steps.speaker: Figure in Black 1
steps.content: That's the ***** who jacked our shipment!
You whip your head toward her. Xiaofeng grins back, the very picture of innocence.

options: Do you just collect enemies everywhere you go?

choices.text: Do you just collect enemies everywhere you go?

steps.content: Before Xiaofeng can respond, a dozen thugs in matching outfits pour out of the truck, flooding the alley and forming a tight circle around you both. The narrow space suddenly feels suffocating.

steps.speaker: Figure in Black 1
steps.content: Hmph! Hand it over. Now. Or you're not walking out of here.
Clack. The sound of rounds being chambered is unnervingly clear and unmistakable.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Heh... A bunch of stray pups, puffing up 'cause the tiger's not home...
With your face still pressed against her chest, you cannot see her expression. But you can feel that coiled energy thrumming through her body.
You do not doubt Xiaofeng's ability to win this fight for a second. The problem lies in the aftermath. If she cuts loose here, in this cramped alley, the collateral damage will be catastrophic.

Your hand moves instinctively toward your pocket, only to remember that your communicator is long gone, tossed aside earlier by the very same Mountain Lord who now holds you captive. You scan your surroundings from the corner of your eye. Surrounded on all sides. No obvious exit. How do you break through? How do you escape?
Your eyes drift upward. Suddenly, an idea clicks into place.
Xiaofeng! Do <color=#fb9259>that thing</color> again! Show them what you've got!

steps.speaker: Figure in Black 1
steps.content: That thing?

steps.speaker: Figure in Black 2
steps.content: What thing?
Hemmed in on all sides with no path forward, you abandon the ground entirely and point straight up instead.

steps.speaker: Figure in Black 2
steps.content: **** the riddles! You cops all brain-dead or what?!

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Oh... that.
A smile tugs at Xiaofeng's lips.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Well. Since you asked so nicely... this Mountain Lord can spare one more show.
Xiaofeng's expression turns serious. She raises a single finger skyward, holds it there for a breath, then slowly draws it back, curling her thumb and index finger into a circle at her lips.
[1s silence, whistle sound, immediately followed by cats yowling]

steps.speaker: Figure in Black 1
steps.content: Huh?! What the—?!

At the whistle's call, countless pairs of eyes ignite in the darkness—pinpricks of eerie luminescence blinking to life all around you. A horde of shrieking creatures plummets from above, diving like living shadows onto the encircling thugs.

steps.speaker: Figures in Black
steps.content: Cats?!

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hahahahahaha—!

Xiaofeng whips her coat forward, shrouding the thugs ahead. A swift kick follows, then a wrist bone cracks with a sickening snap. The gun clatters to the ground, but she snatches it mid-fall and tosses it your way without a second glance.

options: Catch the gun and join the fight!

choices.text: Catch the gun and join the fight!

steps.content: Tiger claws flash. Clubs swing. Fists and feet fly. Modified pistols bark. The narrow alley erupts into utter chaos.

The thud of bone meeting bone, the sharp clang of metal, and a chorus of anguished curses blend into a savage symphony. Bodies stumble and fall back, crashing into one another. Amid the blur of swinging clubs and flashing muzzles, screams and groans rise and fall like a brutal tide.
Finally, only you and Xiaofeng remain standing. The rest sprawl across the ground, a groaning, whimpering carpet of defeat. Only then do you call for Xiaofeng to stand down.
That's enough. We need some of them conscious for questioning.
You approach the cargo truck and begin your search. Pushing aside the top layer of silvervine branches used as camouflage, you pry open the lead-sealed crates.
Level 2 contraband pharmaceuticals. That'll put them away for a while.

You retrieve the gang's communication devices and put in a call to the Syndicate Security Bureau. From the corner of your eye, you notice that Xiaofeng has stopped moving as well. She is now elbow-deep in the crates of contraband, rummaging through them with obvious fascination.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: See? Told you. You locked up all the fun ones. These scraps weren't even a warm-up.
She pulls out a silvervine branch and sticks it between her teeth, then grabs a generous handful and tosses them to the stray cats—her valiant little helpers who answered the whistle's call.

In an instant, the narrow alley fills with cats nuzzling the silvervine and rolling about in pure, unbridled bliss. Their satisfied purrs rise and fall, mingling with the thugs' feeble groans, and together they paint an oddly comical picture.
Even without your tiger, you've got an army of cats on call. That's fitting, Mountain Lord.
Xiaofeng crouches on the ground, running her hand along a calico cat's back with practiced ease, the exact same technique she uses when she strokes her tiger.

You crouch down as well, hoping to pet one yourself, but the cat's ears suddenly perk up, sharp and alert. It springs away and bolts into the shadows before your hand can even reach it. You stare after it, bewildered, until the faint wail of sirens registers in the distance. Of course, these little tigers have far sharper ears than you ever will.
A soft snort of laughter reaches your ears. Xiaofeng stretches languidly, every movement unhurried and feline, and rises to her feet. But you call out to her.
Xiaofeng.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hm?
Next stop. Somewhere more... thrilling. You in?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hah! Lead the way.
[Black Screen]

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: ...Huh. And here I was wondering what you had in mind...

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: So this is what you call more thrilling?
